name: Bio-Thera Solutions, Ltd.
summary: Bio-Thera Solutions, Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, researches and develops novel therapeutics for the treatment of cancer, autoimmune, cardiovascular, eye diseases, and other severe unmet medical needs in China and internationally.
